2026 RATE SCHEDULE
   DRYING RATES: Charged on wet bushels
     15.1%-16.0%    $ 0.05             23.1%-24.0%    $ 0.35

     16.1%-17.0%    $ 0.10             24.1%-25.0%    $ 0.38

     17.1%-18.0%    $ 0.15             25.1%-26.0%    $ 0.41

     18.1%-19.0%    $ 0.20             26.1%-27.0%    $ 0.44

     19.1%-20.0%    $ 0.23             27.1%-28.0%    $ 0.47

     20.1%-21.0%    $ 0.26             28.1%-29.0%    $ 0.50

     21.1%-22.0%    $ 0.29             29.1%-30.0%    $ 0.53

     22.1%-23.0%    $ 0.32             OVER 30.1%     $0.03 per point
   CORN SHRINK:        1.4% per point
                       Shrunk to 14.0% for storage
                       Shrunk to 15.0% for sale/contract/price later

    CORN STORAGE: 24 cents until Jan 1st 2026,
   then $.0015 per day (4.5 cents per month)
    CORN PRICE LATER: 24 cents until Jan 1st 2026,
   then $.0015 per day (4.5 cents per month)

   BEAN MOISTURE DISCOUNT:
   1.5% shrink per ½ point 13.1-15.0%
   2.0% per ½ point over 15.0% (subject to rejection over 15%)
   Excessive green beans/pods will be rejected, at managers discretion

  BEAN STORAGE: 30 cents until Jan 1st 2026,
  then $.0017 per day (5 cents per month)
  BEAN PRICE LATER: 27 cents until Jan 1st 2026,
  then $.0017 per day (5 cents per month)

         A 7 day grace period will apply before storage is charged
Minimum storage and drying will be invoiced and due on January, 11th 2027
    Price later grain may only be sold at the nearby (spot) elevator price
         ALL RATES SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE
